groups.name: usb_in
groups.why: USB-C receptacle with its VBUS ESD (D1, D2), CC ESD (D3, D4) and 5k1 CC pull-downs (R3, R4) at the CC pins, the D+/D- ESD array D5 (TPD2E009) behind the pin row, the shield RC/ferrite to GND (R1, C2, FB1), the VBUS ferrite FB2 and the VBUS cap C4

groups.name: ftdi
groups.why: FT232RQ USB-UART/bit-bang debug bridge: its 3V3OUT/VCCIO decaps C5, C6, its VCC (+5V) decaps C7, C8 and the RESET# pull-up R2; it is the IC nearest the USB connector

groups.name: bridge
groups.why: 0R jumper bank between the FT232R and the STM32: DTR/RTS/DSR/DCD/CTS/RI to the JTAG/SWD/NRST nets (R5-R10), CBUS0 to PC13 (R11), and the straight/crossed UART jumpers (R13-R16); they bridge the two groups

groups.name: power
groups.why: AP7370 LDO +5V -> +3V3 with its input caps C1 (4u7), C3 (100n) and output caps C9, C10 (4u7); the +3V3 and GND test points

groups.name: mcu
groups.why: STM32G474 with its VDD decaps (C11, C12, C15, C17, C18), the VDDA ferrite/caps (FB3, C19, C20), the VREF+ caps (C22, C24), the 32.768 kHz (Y1, C14, C16, R18) and 8 MHz (Y2, C21, C23, R25) crystals, NRST/JTRST/BOOT0 straps (R19, R24, R29, R30, TP8), the JTDI 0R (R20), the 100R I2C series resistors at their driver pins (R21, R22, R23, R27, R28) and the VBAT coin cell holder BAT1 on the back

groups.name: fram
groups.why: MB85RC1MT I2C FRAM with its decap C25, its A1/A2 address straps (R31-R34) and its WP pull-up R26 with test point TP7

groups.name: sensors
groups.why: SHT45 humidity/temperature (U5) and BME280 pressure/humidity (U6) sensors with their decaps (C26 for U5; C27, C28 for U6's VDD/VDDIO) and U6's SDO address strap (R35, R36); held on the slot-isolated NE tongue by the intent block sensor_tongue

groups.name: i2c_conn
groups.why: the two Qwiic JST-SH I2C connectors (J2 front, J3 back) with their SCL/SDA ESD arrays (D6, D8), +3V3 ESD diodes (D7, D9), the 5k1 bus pull-ups (R37, R38), the I2C test points and the connector-side +3V3 cap C13 (the one cap the reference keeps beyond 5 mm of a chip)

groups.name: ui
groups.why: the +5V power LED LD1 with R12 and the PA5 user LED LD2 with R17, each LED with its resistor, toward an edge
